title: Micro-C XL
protocol: Culture 100 mL of yeast to the midlog stage, OD=0.55 overnight.
Add 37% formaldehyde directly to the culture to achieve a final concentration of 3%.
Shake the culture at 210 rpm for 15 min at 30°C (FA only) or 10 min at 30°C (dual crosslinking).
Quench the crosslinking by adding 10 mL of 2.5M Glycine.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the cells at 4000 rpm for 5 min at 4°C.
Pour off the medium and wash the cells in 50 mL of sterile water by vortexing.
Centrifuge the cells at 4000 rpm for 5 min at 4°C.
Pour off the water.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL of Buffer Z and add 7 µL of 2-Mercaptoethanol (final concentration 10mM).
Add 250 µL Zymolyase solution (final concentration 250 µg/mL).
Shake the tube at 210 rpm for 40 min at 30°C.
Centrifuge the cells at 4000 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant with a vacuum suction.
Rinse the permeabilized cells by adding 5 mL cold 1× PBS.
Centrifuge the cells at 4000 rpm for 2 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant with a vacuum suction.
Freshly prepare the long crosslinker stock and working solution as specified (DSG or EGS).
Resuspend the cells homogenously by adding 5 mL of working solution.
Rotate the tube for 40 min at 30°C.
Quench the crosslinking by adding 1 mL of 2.5M Glycine.
Centrifuge the cells at 4000 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant with a vacuum suction.
Rinse the permeabilized cells with 5 mL cold 1× PBS.
Centrifuge the cells at 4000 rpm for 2 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant with a vacuum suction.
Store the crosslinked pellet at -80°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 µL of MBuffer#1 \(freshly complete).
Add MNase to digest chromatin to >95% mononucleosomes.
Incubate the tube for 20 min at 37°C.
Add 2 mM EGTA and incubate the tube for 10 min at 65°C to stop MNase activity.
Transfer the whole sample into a 0.5 mL Amicon 10K spin column.
Concentrate the sample at 16000xg at 4°C until volume decreases to ~50 µL.
Wash / pipette the sample with 450 µL MBuffer#2.
Repeat wash and concentration steps as necessary.
Concentrate the sample at 16000xg for at 4°C until the volume goes down to ~ 30 µL.
Add BSA to 1× final concentration.
Centrifuge the tube at 16000xg for 5 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant.
Concentrate the sample by the 0.5 mL Amicon 10K spin column at 16000xg for at 4°C until the volume goes down to ~ 50 µL.
Wash / pipette the sample by 450 µL MBuffer#2.
Repeat wash step 2 - 3.
Concentrate the sample at 16000xg for at 4°C until the volume goes down to ~ 30 µL.
Add BSA to 1× final concentration.
Centrifuge the tube at 16000xg for 5 min at 4°C.
Collect the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL MBuffer#2.
Centrifuge the tube at 16000xg for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the buffer with a vacuum suction.
Repeat wash steps 3 - 5.
Resuspend the pellet to 30 µL of MBuffer#2 + final 1× BSA \(or NEBuffer 2.1).
Incubate the sample for 45min at 37°C.
Inactivate the sample for 5min at 65°C.
Incubate the chromatin sample with r-Shrimp alkaline phosphatase and other components at 37°C for 45 min.
Inactivate the de-phosphorylation reaction for 5 min at 65°C.
Incubate the chromatin sample from VI.1 with NEBuffer#2, ATP, BSA, DTT, T4 DNA polymerase, and T4 PNK at 37°C for 7 min.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 25 minutes at 25°C.
Reduce temperature and incubate for 15 minutes at 12°C.
Cool down to 4°C.
Add EDTA to achieve a final concentration of 30 mM.
Heat inactivate the reaction mix for 20 minutes at 65°C.
Incubate the ligation reaction mixture for 60 minutes at room temperature.
Pellet samples by centrifuging at 16000xg for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Centrifuge total and supernatant samples through Amicon 30k concentrators at 4000g for 40 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate the reaction mixture with Exonuclease III for 5 minutes at 37°C.
Add 20X proteinase K to achieve a final concentration of 1× and incubate overnight at 55°C.
Perform phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extraction twice.
Centrifuge the extract at 19800xg for 10 minutes.
Add 0.1x volume of sodium acetate and 2.5x volume of 100% ethanol to the sample.
Incubate the mixture at -80°C for more than one hour.
Spin the mixture at 19800xg for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the pellet with 75% ethanol.
Spin the mixture at 19800xg for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Air dry the pellet for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in 50 μL of TE buffer containing RNase solution.
Incubate the sample for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Purify DNA using ZymoClean method.
Run DNA samples on a 3% Nusieve agarose DNA gel.
Select the band between 250 - 350 bp from the gel.
Perform ZymoGel purification and dissolve the final product in 17 μL of elution buffer.
Quantify input DNA using Qubit.
Incubate 25 µL of DNA with 10× End-it buffer, 10× ATP, 10× dNTP, and End-it enzyme mix for 45 minutes at room temperature.
Purify the mixture twice using Ampure XP.
Incubate 25 µL of DNA with 10X Exo-Klenow buffer, 1 mM dATP, and Exo-Klenow fragment enzyme for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Purify the mixture twice using Ampure XP.
Mix in-line/indexing adapter ratio of Adapter:Input DNA = 10:1 – 50:1 with water to a total volume of 15 µL, adding Fast-link DNA ligase buffer and ATP.
Incubate for more than two hours at room temperature.
Add 10 µL of EB to the mixture to reach a total volume of 25 µL.
Purify using Ampure XP twice and elute DNA in 150 µL of water.
Wash 2.5 µL of beads per sample with TBW twice.
Resuspend washed beads in 150 µL of 2× BW.
Mix with 150 µL of adapter-ligated DNA sample.
Rotate for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash with 500 µL of 1× TBW twice.
Rinse with 200 µL of MBuffer#2.
Resuspend in 15 – 20 µL of EB buffer.
Perform on-beads PCR using the following components: Streptavidin-Biotin-DNA sample, water, 2× KAPA HiFi Hot Start Mix, PE1 primer, and PE2 primer.
Denature at 98°C for 45 sec.
Cycle through denaturation (98°C for 15 sec), annealing (60°C for 30 sec), and elongation (72°C for 30 sec) for 8-12 cycles.
Extend at 72°C for 1 min.
Hold at 4°C.
Check the size and quantity of library by DNA gel or Fragment analyzer.
Size-select dimer size library using a 3% Nusieve agarose DNA gel or 1:1 Ampure XP beads purification.
Perform deep sequencing by Illumina PE-50.
